title: Wizards Play Network 2024: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Every setback and every triumph had led to this: the moment when she played her last card and knew without a doubt she had won.
"Ooh, a Tide Shaper! This is going straight into my Svyelun deck."
Not even the cold embrace of death could keep him from his Prerelease events.
He stepped inside, then stared in awe. Never before had he imagined such joy and wonder could be contained all in one place.
With the right tool, nothing is impossible.
If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.
Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.
The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.
No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.
"Nope, no monsters in the forest. Nothing in there but squirrels." —Joskun, An-Havva constable
Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?" —Vraska
